problem_text:
A logistics firm is tasked with distributing nine distinct categories of cargo, each necessitating nine sequential handling stages for preparation and dispatch. The revenue generated per metric ton for each cargo category is outlined below:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 13.849 per metric ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 11.644 per metric ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 12.788 per metric ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 19.557 per metric ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 5.576 per metric ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 18.103 per metric ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 11.502 per metric ton
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 17.686 per metric ton
* For Cargo Iota, revenue is 18.141 per metric ton

The handling duration required per metric ton for each stage is as follows:
*For Cargo Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.526 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.053 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.139 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.273 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.912 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.484 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.739 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.807 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.918 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Beta, Stage 1 consumes 1.213 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.729 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.493 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.507 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.706 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.656 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.905 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.834 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.88 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.743 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.66 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.998 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.69 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.757 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.25 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.914 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.683 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.682 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.868 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.941 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.338 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.225 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.164 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.589 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.536 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.973 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.489 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.629 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.591 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.659 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.487 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.29 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.295 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.773 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.988 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.668 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.166 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.088 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.23 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.288 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.539 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.087 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.385 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.138 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.235 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Eta, Stage 1 consumes 1.986 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.358 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.871 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.182 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.623 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.791 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.316 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 1.38 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 1.81 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Theta, Stage 1 consumes 1.626 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.245 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.222 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.943 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.328 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.933 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 1.688 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.823 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.381 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Iota, Stage 1 consumes 1.215 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.834 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.502 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.707 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.275 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.673 (ton-hours), Stage 7 consumes 0.215 (ton-hours), Stage 8 consumes 0.62 (ton-hours), Stage 9 consumes 0.975 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 1 must not surpass 220.786 hours
* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 2 must not surpass 167.784 hours
* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 3 must not surpass 196.169 hours
* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 4 must not surpass 155.618 hours
* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 5 must not surpass 205.768 hours
* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 6 must not surpass 162.271 hours
* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 7 must not surpass 263.208 hours
* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 8 must not surpass 152.745 hours
* The cumulative handling duration allocated to Stage 9 must not surpass 191.741 hours

Under the condition that for each handling stage—Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Stage 4, Stage 5, Stage 6, Stage 7, Stage 8, and Stage 9—the total processing duration remains within its respective available time budget, determine the optimal allocation of metric tons for each cargo category to maximize the aggregate revenue.
